name: Jobs Wife
overview: The character of Job's wife is briefly but poignantly presented in Scripture, highlighting a moment of profound testing in the life of Job, who was described as perfect, upright, and God-fearing. In the midst of Job's suffering, his wife challenges his faith by urging him to curse God and die, revealing a response that contrasts sharply with Job's integrity. This encounter invites reflection on the qualities of a godly woman, as Proverbs 31 praises the virtuous woman whose value far exceeds rubies, setting a standard for faithfulness and trust in God even amidst trials.
